game_concept: A strategy race set in Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip, a shipyard building boats: the fisher must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Branching Tale: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings.
theme: Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip: a shipyard building boats
core_gameplay_loop: In Shipyard Slip, repeat each round: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fisher ahead. Then check the story_trust value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the dock crane by solving code steps involving story_trust that move the fisher forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the dock crane first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 4 (applied tier): Branching Tale
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Branching Tale' (Week 3 slot 12), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Shipyard Slip'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how story_trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Shipyard Slip.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
